value.rationale: Nauru is the canonical 24-vertex cubic symmetric graph and a 4-star Cayley interconnection network. This exhaustive exact dynamical portrait identifies a sharp convergence cutoff, a 17/1147 symmetry resolution, and a substantial 462400-versus-1936 basin separation for fixed points. It is a motivated complete classification of a natural finite object rather than an arbitrary slice or generic two-period deduction.
